company.name: Ghinwa
company.shortDescription: Ghinwa is a karaoke and music-sharing platform helping singers showcase talent and build fan communities.
company.description: Ghinwa is a music and karaoke mobile platform enabling amateur singers to record, share, and promote performances online. The application supports karaoke, cover songs, and self-broadcasting features that help users build audiences and showcase musical talent. Founded in 2015, Ghinwa focuses on empowering creative expression across the Middle East through interactive digital entertainment, social engagement, and music-driven community experiences.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,000,000, or 94.64% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,902,634 to $12,271,244, a 6.45x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
